business_problem: unify fragmented insurance data so business users, regulators, and field operations could get faster answers without performance bottlenecks.
solution_summary: Forte Insurance uses Snowflake on Snowflake to unify fragmented insurance data so business users, regulators, and field operations could get faster answers without performance bottlenecks. Insurance data from previously fragmented operational systems are unified in Snowflake and exposed through specialized marts for business users and field teams. The modernized platform uses shared governed data and optimized marts to reduce bottlenecks, improve cache reuse, and make reporting and operational queries much more responsive. Underwriters, claims teams, surveyors, and reporting users consume the outputs through dashboards and operational lookups that now refresh almost in real time. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and applications.
